title: AINumbers trust-signals digest (ainumbers.co/trust-signals/v1)
description: Normative schema for .well-known/trust-signals.json — the machine-readable digest of facts the site's public gates already compute (SPEC §18 proof coverage, §18 receipt digest freshness, kernel determinism, transparency-log anchors, citation-drift budget, receipt-conformance corpus). The file is a SHARED DERIVED ARTIFACT with a single writer: scripts/gen-trust-signals.mjs regenerates it on main after every merge (derived-artifacts-regen.yml); every number is read from a gate, never typed. Consumers MUST ignore unknown members; this schema never sets additionalProperties to false at the top level. Local enforcement uses the zero-dependency keyword subset implemented in scripts/check-trust-signals.mjs (types, required, const, pattern, minimum, items); keywords outside that subset are documentation.

schema.description: Wire discriminator naming the digest dialect. v1 is pre-stable: consumers MUST ignore unknown members and MUST NOT attempt to interpret a schema value they do not implement.

generated_at.description: Committer timestamp (UTC, ISO 8601) of the commit named by `commit` — the state of main the digest describes. Derived, never wall-clock, so a regeneration is byte-reproducible at the same commit (the derived-artifacts idempotency doctrine).

commit.description: Full git sha of the main commit whose tree the digest's facts were computed from. Anchored to the most recent commit that is not the mechanical chore(derived) regen-bot commit, so the file stays byte-stable across the bot's own commit cycle (a self-referential HEAD sha could never reach a fixpoint). On main this equals HEAD except in that one mechanical window, where it equals HEAD^; scripts/check-trust-signals.mjs asserts exactly this on main.

signals.description: The digest body: one member per published signal family. Every number is computed by a public gate script at regeneration time.

proof_coverage.description: SPEC §18 compute-integrity proof coverage over LIVE gpu:false nodes, classified by scripts/check-compute-proof-coverage.mjs's own evaluateCoverage().

covered.description: Live gpu:false nodes carrying a well-formed audit_signature.compute_proof.

total.description: All live gpu:false nodes in §18 scope (proven + deferred + missing).

digest_freshness.description: §18 receipt digest freshness over live gpu:false proven nodes, computed by scripts/check-s18-digest-freshness.mjs's own computeStaleness() against the currently-deployed kernel sources. Stale means the receipt attests to an earlier kernel revision — never that the proof is invalid.

fresh.description: Receipts whose journal.kernel_digest matches a fresh recompute of the deployed kernel source.

stale.description: Receipts attesting to an earlier kernel revision (seal still cryptographically valid).

determinism.description: Static kernel-determinism lint posture, from scripts/check-kernel-determinism.mjs and its committed allowlist.

static_clean.description: True iff scripts/check-kernel-determinism.mjs exits 0 at regeneration time (zero new locale/time/random/env-sensitive constructs; the gate is hard in CI, so a shipped digest is always clean).

allowlisted.description: Kernel files deliberately allowlisted for engine-approximated transcendentals (scripts/kernel-determinism-allowlist.json, transcendentals.files).

anchors.description: Transparency-log anchor records binding published artifacts into public logs.

sigsum.description: Latest published Sigsum anchor of the registry-lineage log, read from registry/lineage/checkpoint.sigsum-record.json.

latest_leaf.description: inclusion_proof.leaf_index of the latest published lineage anchor.

cosigners.description: witness_cosignatures count carried by that anchor record.

rekor.description: Latest published Sigstore Rekor entry, read from scripts/register-rekor.fixtures.json (the tracked copy of the real record).

latest_entry.description: Hex UUID of the Rekor (hashedrekord) entry — 64 hex for classic leaf-hash UUIDs, 80 hex for the newer transparent-entry format.

citation_drift.description: Citation-drift ratchet posture, read from scripts/citation-drift-baseline.json.

baseline.description: Known findings shielded by the citation-drift baseline (advisory pre-existing debt; any NEW finding blocks the gate).

conformance_corpus.description: The public OCG receipt-conformance corpus, read from ocg-conformance/vectors/manifest.json.

vectors.description: Vector count in the corpus manifest.

manifest_version.description: The corpus manifest's own version string.

verify.description: How a third party re-derives every number in this file.

how.description: One sentence pointing at the public gate scripts.
